name: Community Youth Center Youth Job Fair
org: Community Youth Center of San Francisco
what_you_do: You can attend this one-day job fair. You meet employers, learn about openings, get resume help, practice interviews, take headshots and get free professional clothing.
pay_detail: Free to attend. Employers share job openings, but the page does not say if those jobs are paid.
deadline_text: The 2026 fair was October 14, 2026 at Stonestown Galleria. The sf.gov youth page no longer lists it, and no next date is posted.
how_to_apply: The 2026 fair is over, so there is nothing to sign up for now. Check the city's youth opportunities page for the next fair.
notes: The page does not list which employers will attend. It is a free event, not a job offer.
